Chief_Complaint.content: 3-day history of diarrhea, vomiting, and feeling feverish

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea started watery and is now very loose
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Diarrhea started watery → now very loose

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea has occurred at least four times today
Patient feels feverish or 'boiling' without a thermometer reading
Vomiting everything including water and tea
Last vomiting episode was about 2 hours ago after breakfast
Periumbilical pain that is very tender around the navel
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Periumbilical pain, very tender around navel

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Periumbilical pain associated with urges to open bowels
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: urges to open bowels with pain

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last passed urine about 1 hour ago
Urine color has not been assessed

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No blood in stool or urine
No blood in stool or urine

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Baseline bowel habit is once daily with no prior diarrhea or constipation
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Baseline bowels: daily, once; no prior diarrhea/constipation

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Close contact with brother who has similar symptoms
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: close contact: brother with similar sx

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports a school outbreak of similar illness

Medications.content: Uses ibuprofen as needed for menstrual cramps
Taking oral rehydration solution three times per day for the past two days

Social_and_Family_History.content: Drinks alcohol as an occasional pint
Working from home today due to illness
Last menstrual period was approximately 2 weeks ago

Assessment.content: Three days of watery then loose diarrhea, vomiting, feeling feverish, periumbilical cramps, contact with symptomatic brother, and no blood in stool
Assessment.source_text: 3 days watery→loose diarrhea, vomiting, feverish; periumbilical cramps; contact with symptomatic brother; no blood.

Assessment.content: Ongoing vomiting and difficulty retaining fluids but still passing urine
Assessment.source_text: ongoing vomiting, difficulty retaining fluids; still passing urine.

Plan_of_Care.content: Take tiny frequent sips of fluids continuously
Eat simple foods only such as toast or biscuits
Provide stool sample for bacterial testing
Arrange urgent clinic appointment today to submit stool sample and assess hydration
Plan_of_Care.source_text: arrange urgent clinic appt today to submit sample and assess hydration

Plan_of_Care.content: Maintain small, frequent sips of fluids or oral rehydration solution
Plan_of_Care.source_text: maintain small, frequent sips of fluids/ORS

Follow_up_Information.content: If symptoms worsen or patient is unable to keep fluids down, attend A&E
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if worsening/unable to keep fluids down, attend A&E

Follow_up_Information.content: Call back if feeling more unwell
